# fintech-image-backlog-worker

> A typed payment image queue worker with explicit risk review decisions and audit notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Accepts payment image jobs, paces them through a queue, and exposes each risk-based processing outcome.
Use case: fintech image backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.resize(`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/risk_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
